name: Lesson path
summary: A learning path: the daily streak, XP and a daily goal ring, the unit with its cover photo, and lessons as round steps down a winding path, done, up next and locked, with a card under the chosen lesson to start or practise it.
use: on the home screen of a language or learning app, for picking the next lesson
a11y: The path is an ordered list; each lesson is a button named with its number, title and state, the next one has aria-current="step", locked ones are disabled, and the lesson card is a polite live region.

use_when: a course home where the learner should see what is done, what is next and what is still locked in one unit
avoid_when: daily habits to tick off by day: use habit-tracker
steps to set up an account or product: use setup-steps
one question inside a lesson: use quiz-question

parts.name: stats
parts.what: streak, total XP and today's XP against the goal, as three tiles

parts.name: goal
parts.what: a ring showing today's XP toward the goal

parts.name: unit
parts.what: the unit title, under a unit and section line

parts.name: guide
parts.what: opens the unit's words and phrases

parts.name: lessons
parts.what: one lesson as a round step on the winding path: done, up next or locked

parts.name: card_title
parts.what: the chosen lesson's title in the card under it

parts.name: card_sub
parts.what: the chosen lesson's place and XP

parts.name: start
parts.what: starts or practises the chosen lesson

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the path fails to load, keep the banner and put an alert-banners line where the path goes

disabled.how: locked lessons are off, show a lock and cannot be chosen

overflow.how: on phones the card padding and the path's side-to-side step get smaller so the path fits

long_text.how: the unit title wraps beside the guide button, and the lesson card is capped in width so its text wraps

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches the guide button, each lesson that is not locked, and Start lesson in the card
Enter or Space on a lesson chooses it; the card moves under it with that lesson's title and button label, and the change is announced
Locked lessons are skipped by Tab
The guide and Start lesson buttons have no action wired in the file
